description: Minimal M2M with client_secret_post, 300-second access tokens and empty scopes. Native signing algorithms are preserved. Native claim and extra-token work is explicitly listed below; it remains part of measured cost. Optional hs256 and rs256 profiles only check signing comparability.

authentik.id_token: Pinned Authentik returns an ID token even for empty-scope client_credentials. This is additional native issuance work, retained in timings and response size; these are not equivalent single-token operations.
